display_long_description:
Folk Valley is a multiplayer VR horror game where you move like an ape: swing, climb and run on your arms through the backrooms, while something hunts you.

THE BACKROOMS
Endless yellow halls, a pitch-black pillar hall, flickering offices and floors that drop out under you. Every room looks the same. Every light might be the last one.

CAPTAIN CLARK
Two of him roam the dark. He hears you, he sees you, and he runs. If he catches you, he lifts you off the ground for everyone nearby to see. Then you wake up back at spawn.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Explore together, split up, hold the doors shut and pull each other out of trouble. Chat by voice, pick your colour and meet up in the spawn room.

MOD MENUS
Six mod menus, from the Rusty Menu to the Captain's Menu: flashlight, night vision, low gravity, platforms, flying, big and tiny ape, rainbow fur and more. Hold X and it opens on your left hand.

SOUNDBOARDS
Three soundboards packed with goofy sounds (air horn, sad trombone, metal pipe, duck, kazoo) that everyone around you hears. Hold A and it opens on your right hand.

Pick which menu and board you wear in the spawn wardrobes.

Folk Valley has scary moments, chases and some blood. Turn your volume up and keep your arms moving.
